senses.gloss: (in Y. Dial.) מוּנְדְּרָן, מִנְדְּרָן m. (v. מִדְרָא a. נְדַר II) sloping; מקום מ׳ declivity.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 11:3:3">Y. Sabb. XI, 13ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>בשהיה המקום מונ׳</he> when the place was sloping; Y. Erub. X, 26ᵃ bot. <cite ref="M00539"><he>מנ׳</he></cite>; Y. B. Bath. I, end, 13ᵃ <cite ref="M01722"><he>מִנְדְּרוֹן</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1:7">Y. Erub. I, 18ᶜ</cite> top <he>היה מונ׳ וכ׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="M02395"><he>מקום</he></cite>) if there was a declivity in the middle of the alley. Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ bot. <cite ref="M00539"><he>מנ׳</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 4:10">Tosef. Mikv. IV, 10</cite> (expl. <cite ref="H01605"><he>חַרְדְּלִית</he></cite>) <he>מי גשמים הבאין מד׳</he> (Maim. to <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 5:6">Mikv. V, 6</cite> <he>מן חמ׳</he>) rain water that runs down a declivity.
